data.title: Tharattazhaku · Celebrate Pregnancy
data.excerpt: Kinder's pregnancy fashion show celebrates expectant mothers, their families and the memories made before birth.
data.body:
Tharattazhaku is Kinder Kochi's pregnant women's fashion show, created to make pregnancy a time of celebration, confidence and shared memories. Expectant mothers take the stage with family and community support.

## A celebration beyond the runway

Kinder's pregnancy celebrations have included the Tharattazhaku fashion show, MomMix cake mixing, Spandanan music competition, Kin Baby Bloom baby shower and antenatal classes. Ask the Kochi team which programmes are currently scheduled.

## The Tharattazhaku story

The first season in 2022 brought 48 expectant mothers onto the runway after approximately 70 women were screened. The 2023 season featured around 100 participants and received India Book of Records and Asia Book of Records recognition. The 2024 Season 3 programme invited expectant mothers from across India and aimed for more than 100 participants. These are highlights of past events, not a current registration announcement.

## Join a future celebration

To ask about upcoming Tharattazhaku events, eligibility, registration and antenatal programmes, contact the Kinder Kochi team. Dates and availability are confirmed by the hospital.

data.title: WOW MOM · Kinder Pregnancy Club
data.excerpt: A supportive pregnancy club for learning, wellbeing, friendship and moments worth celebrating at Kinder Kochi.
data.body:
WOW MOM brings expectant mothers together through education, wellbeing activities and celebrations during pregnancy. The club offers a place to connect, ask questions and prepare for birth and the first weeks of parenting.

## Antenatal learning

Classes and expert-led sessions cover nutrition, fetal development, breastfeeding, labour, pain-management options, newborn care and parenting. Birth-preparation sessions discuss breathing techniques, labour positions and partner support.

## Wellbeing and connection

The club describes pregnancy-appropriate physiotherapy, yoga, gentle exercise and wellness activities, alongside group discussions and access to reading resources. Participation in physical activities should be discussed with the care team for individual suitability. Supportive conversations and mental-health resources are part of the programme.

## Events and shared moments

Baby showers, maternity photography, pregnancy fashion shows, games and other gatherings help members celebrate together. Activity schedules and individual services may vary.

## Joining WOW MOM

The club welcomes expectant mothers. Ask the Kochi team about current sessions, registration, any membership fee and participation guidelines. Members are expected to respect each other's privacy and experiences.
